description:
This individual will be part of an autonomous, cross-functional team that will typically include a product owner (team lead); a scrum master (agile methods lead); an information architect; a content lead; a social business manager; a designer; one or more developers; and a metrics analyst. Applicants should be detail-oriented, self-motivated, highly organized, and able to work in a team environment.  
 

 Responsibilities
 • Integration of enterprise APIs to build a world class digital presence
 • Seamless back-end integration of social tools, feeds, interfaces for an enterprise web presence
 

 Skills
 • Background in highly scalable and/or highly reliable systems is strongly preferred
 • Experience building distributed systems in Java
 • Strong competency in Object Oriented Programming
 • Experienced in building RESTful web services
 • Experience with Agile Methodologies, preferably Scrum
 • J2EE, XML processing, XSL, Java Design Patterns, SVN, jUnit, Ant, AJAX, JQuery, Dojo, Web Services
 • Experienced on AIX and Linux 
 • Cross-browser knowledge
 • Rational Application Development IDE experience
 • At least 5 years of practical software development experience on a commercial project
 

 Education
 • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
